faq.q: Should I choose a group course or one-to-one lessons?
faq.a: A group course gives you a set level, a clear structure and a live group. One-to-one lessons are built around your own goals and timetable. If you are not sure, tell us your goal and we will suggest one.

faq.q: How long is a group course?
faq.a: A level course lasts 12 weeks and has 72 lessons. It covers four skills, grammar, vocabulary and assessments.

faq.q: Can I try before I pay?
faq.a: Yes. You can join one live group class free of charge to see how we teach. Use the free class page to ask.

faq.q: How do I pay?
faq.a: By bank transfer, after the office confirms your place. We send the bank details with your booking confirmation.

faq.q: How much is IELTS preparation?
faq.a: Exam preparation is £320 for 24 hours of tuition, usually over six to eight weeks. One-to-one lessons are £15 per 55 minute lesson.

faq.q: Does the price include the exam?
faq.a: No. Exam entry fees are separate and are paid to the exam body. We do not run tests.

faq.q: Can you promise the score I need?
faq.a: No. Your result depends on your work and on the test. We can teach and prepare you, and tell you honestly what to practise.

faq.q: I am a nurse. Should I choose IELTS or OET?
faq.a: That depends on what your regulator accepts, so check with them first. See our OET page for lessons built around the OET sub-tests and your profession.

placement.lead: Twelve short questions that give a rough idea of your level, from A1 to B2. It takes about five minutes.
placement.guide: This is a rough guide, not an assessment. It cannot replace a conversation with a tutor, and it does not predict a result in any exam.
placement.instruction: Choose one answer for each question.
placement.missing: Please answer every question. You have not answered: {list}.
placement.noscript: The quiz needs JavaScript. You can still send us an enquiry and we will suggest a level.

results.A1: Start with the basics: simple sentences, everyday words and speaking with confidence. A tutor can build from here at your pace.
results.A2: You can handle simple everyday English. The next step is longer sentences and more natural speaking.
results.B1: You can manage most everyday situations. Work on fluency, a wider vocabulary and speaking with fewer pauses.
results.B2: You have a solid level. Lessons can focus on accuracy, range and your specific goal, such as work or a test.

faqPage.lead: Short answers to what people ask us most. If yours is not here, send an enquiry.

items.q: How much do lessons cost?
items.a: One-to-one lessons are £15 per 55 minute lesson, or £20 if the lesson is taught entirely in English. An online group course is £298 per level course. Exam preparation is £320 for 24 hours of tuition.

items.q: Which platform do lessons use?
items.a: Group courses run live on Zoom. One-to-one lessons run on a live video call, and we send you the link with your booking.

items.q: How do I pay?
items.a: By bank transfer, after the office confirms your place. We send the bank details with your booking confirmation. We do not take card payments on the site.

items.q: Can I try a class before I pay?
items.a: Yes. You can join one live group class free of charge to see how we teach. Use the free class page to ask.

items.q: What levels do you teach?
items.a: Group courses run at A1, A2, B1 and B2. One-to-one lessons are available at any level.

items.q: How long is a group course?
items.a: A level course is 12 weeks and 72 lessons in a small live group of no more than 12 learners.

items.q: How long is a one-to-one lesson?
items.a: 55 minutes.

items.q: Can I change or cancel a lesson?
items.a: You can reschedule a one-to-one lesson once, with at least 48 hours notice by email, text or phone. With less than 48 hours notice the lesson is charged.

items.q: What if I am ill?
items.a: Illness is considered case by case, and we answer within ten working days.

items.q: What if a group does not run?
items.a: A group runs when enough learners have booked. If it does not run, your deposit is refunded or moved.

items.q: Do you teach children?
items.a: Yes. Our teachers teach children and adults. We offer one-to-one lessons for school age children, and a parent or carer is present or nearby during the lesson.

items.q: Do you run the IELTS, OET or B1 tests?
items.a: No. We teach and prepare you, but we do not run tests. You book the test separately and pay the test fee to the test provider.

items.q: Can you promise I will pass my test?
items.a: No. Your result depends on your own work and on the test. We cannot promise a result.

items.q: Which B1 test do I need for my visa or citizenship?
items.a: That depends on your own route, so please check gov.uk before you book a test. We cannot advise on immigration.

items.q: Do you have Bulgarian speaking tutors?
items.a: Yes, Bulgarian speaking tutors are available for one-to-one lessons. Tell us in the enquiry form if you would like one.

items.q: I live outside the UK. Can I join?
items.a: One-to-one lessons are timetabled with your tutor, so tell us your time zone in the enquiry form and we will say what is possible.

items.q: Are your tutors qualified?
items.a: Our tutors hold degrees in English philology or TEFL qualifications, and one holds a CELTA. See the tutors page for the qualifications each tutor has shared.

items.q: Do you offer classroom lessons?
items.a: Not on this site. Ucraya is for online lessons. For classroom lessons in London, visit ucraya.co.uk.

items.q: How do I start?
items.a: Send an enquiry with your goal. The office replies by email with a tutor and a first lesson to suggest.

items.q: Is there a discount if I bring a friend?
items.a: Yes. For one-to-one lessons, 2 free lessons for 1 friend, 4 for 2 and 6 for 3, if the friend studies at least two months with two lessons a week. For group courses, two people booking together get 20% off the level, and three get one module free.

privacy.lead: How Ucraya uses your details, in plain English.

sections.title: Who we are
body: Ucraya is a trading name of Training Centre Raya London Ltd, company number 11618355. Our registered address is 7 Corporation Street, London E15 3HB. We are registered with the Information Commissioner's Office (reference ZA491449).
You can contact us about your details at office@ucraya.co.uk.

sections.title: What we collect
body: When you send an enquiry we collect what you type in the form: your name, email address, and, if you add them, your phone or WhatsApp number, first language, goal, preferred format, level, preferred days and times and your message.
The placement test runs in your browser. Your answers are not sent to us. If you press the button to enquire, only the level it estimated is placed in the form.
We do not collect card details. Payment is by bank transfer.

sections.title: Why we use your details
body: We use your details to reply to your enquiry, to suggest a tutor and a first lesson, and to arrange and confirm lessons if you go ahead. This is so we can take the steps you ask for, and it is part of running our school.

sections.title: Who can see them
body: Your enquiry is delivered to the school office by email. It is handled through the form service of our website host, Netlify. We do not sell your details and we do not share them for advertising.

sections.title: Cookies and analytics
body: This site does not set cookies of its own. If we switch on Google Analytics to see which pages are useful, we will ask you first with a cookie banner, and nothing from Google is loaded unless you accept. You can change your mind by clearing this site's data in your browser.

sections.title: How long we keep them
body: We keep your enquiry details for as long as we need them to deal with your enquiry and any lessons that follow, and to meet our legal duties.

sections.title: Your rights
body: You can ask us to show you the details we hold about you, correct them, delete them, restrict how we use them or stop using them. Write to office@ucraya.co.uk and we will reply.
If you are unhappy with how we use your details, you can complain to the Information Commissioner's Office at ico.org.uk.

terms.lead: How booking, payment and cancellation work, in plain English.

sections.title: About these terms
body: Ucraya is a trading name of Training Centre Raya London Ltd, company number 11618355, registered at 7 Corporation Street, London E15 3HB. These terms cover the online lessons sold through this site.

sections.title: Booking and payment
body: You enquire through the site. The office replies by email, and when you are happy, the office confirms your place and sends the bank details with your booking confirmation.
Payment is by bank transfer only. We do not take card payments on the site and we never ask for your card details.

sections.title: Online group courses
body: A level course costs £298. A £50 deposit secures your place and is part of the £298. The balance of £248 is paid in two parts: £124 at the start of the course and £124 at the third lesson.
The deposit is not refundable, but it can be moved to another group of the same course and level. A group runs when it has enough students. If a group does not run, the deposit is refunded or moved.
A postponed course must be finished within the year it started. A course cannot be postponed twice.

sections.title: One-to-one lessons
body: One-to-one lessons are £15 per 55 minute lesson, or £20 per 55 minute lesson when taught entirely in English. You pay per lesson or in blocks agreed with the office.

sections.title: Rescheduling and cancellation
body: You can reschedule a one-to-one lesson once, with at least 48 hours notice by email, text or phone. With less than 48 hours notice, the lesson is charged.
Illness is considered case by case, and we answer within ten working days.

sections.title: Exams and results
body: Exam entry fees are separate and are paid to the exam body. We do not run tests. We teach and prepare you, but we cannot promise a result in any test.

sections.title: Free class
body: You can join one live group class free of charge to see how we teach.

sections.title: Bring a friend
body: For one-to-one lessons, bringing a friend earns free lessons: 2 for 1 friend, 4 for 2 friends and 6 for 3 friends. The friend must study for at least two months with two lessons a week. For group courses, two people booking together get 20% off the level, and three get one module free.

sections.title: Questions
body: If anything here is unclear, write to office@ucraya.co.uk before you book.
